name: profile-record
title: Customer profile review record
for_each: select id,code as name from profiles order by code

sections.title: Reviewed source links
sections.sql: select l.source,l.external_id,l.full_name,l.email,l.reviewed_by,l.reason from record_lineage l join memberships m on m.record_id=l.id where m.profile_id=$1 order by l.source,l.external_id

sections.title: Recorded preferences
sections.note: Preferences are scoped to channel and purpose. This document does not authorise a message.
sections.sql: select channel,purpose,decision,observed_on,evidence from latest_consent where profile_id=$1 order by channel,purpose

name: source-register
title: Source purpose and retention review
for_each: select id,code as name from sources order by code

sections.title: Records requiring retention review
sections.note: Review other retention duties before deletion. This system never deletes customer records automatically.
sections.sql: select external_id,full_name,collected_on,retention_until from source_records where source_id=$1 and retention_until<current_date order by retention_until
